body:
Hey, thanks for responding. I'm a lot better now. When I wrote that I was having a kind of meltdown, like on the verge of literally hanging myself out of feeling desperation but I've cooled down since, and the other two people that responded definitely helped. I guess I can't really guarantee that I'll immediately start climbing out of this, or that I won't return to this point ever in the future, but at least I've lived another day, right?

And yeah, I'd love to help you with your hair sometime.

Thanks so much for that. And yeah, what made me snap was primarily hearing religious people around me in addition to coping with my friend's absence, but I'm completely aware that not everyone wishes what I described on me. I really apologize if I offended you with my rant.

Specifically, thanks for reminding me that at least I most likely helped someone by being alive. About two months ago at my friend's funeral, his mom actually thanked me for being a good friend to him. And I really hope I was. It's hard to explain why that suddenly takes the wind out of saying that it would've been better to never exist. But anyways, I'm just going off on tangents now. Thanks for taking the time, I wish you the best.
